# Vulpkanin
## General information
Their sharp claws make their unarmed attacks deal Slash damage, rather than Blunt.
Their animal-like digestive systems can process raw meat and blood without any ill effects, but are poisoned by chemicals such as allicin (found in garlic and onions) and theobromine (found in caffeinated beverages and chocolate).
Their weirdly shaped muzzle leads to difficulties drinking, making them sometimes spill small amounts of whatever they drink onto the ground.
They take [color=#1e90ff]15% less Cold damage[/color], but [color=#ffa500]15% more Heat damage[/color]. Their dense fur makes them prefer a somewhat colder temperature range than humans, and also makes them [color=#ffa500]extremely vulnerable to fire[/color].
## Leaping
Vulpkanins' digitigrade legs give them the ability to leap an impressive distance. This is useful for leaping over ground-based hazards (such as bottomless chasms or slippery puddles), or just as a quick burst of speed to escape a dangerous situation or chase someone down.
Be careful not to crash into anything mid-leap, or you'll fall to the ground and drop what you're holding!
